english.meaning: not merely; far from, used before 唔係
english.note: This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: I’m really young—not just not old.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我年紀直程細喇。點只唔係好大。

exampleSentences.english: It’s not just not ( ); it’s downright small. But then again, you can’t really call it small—it’s a bit... well, that.
exampleSentences.traditional: 點只唔係（），直程細，噉又唔可以話細真係。話細有啲那個咗少少。
